result.title: PnP-CF: A Consensus Flow-Matching Solver for General Inverse Problems
result.comment: Short version accepted at PriGM Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
result.summary: Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods using continuous-time deep generative models as learned data distribution priors enable synthesizing high-quality solutions of model-based inverse problems. The quality of the solutions depends critically on the interplay and consensus between the inverse problem solver and the generative model sampler. We revisit a recently introduced flow-based PnP framework, which we refer to as PnP-CF (Consensus Flow), and extend its application to nonlinear inverse problems, including those with learned neural-network forward operators. PnP-CF combines a flow-matching denoiser with (i) ADMM-like dual variable updates and (ii) a time-adaptive pullback onto the intermediate flow probability path that combines a stochastic and a deterministic component. We discuss how these two features stabilize the algorithm and promote consensus, and demonstrate on a set of experiments that PnP-CF not only solves standard linear inverse problems with quality at least comparable to state-of-the-art baselines, but also extends gracefully to nonlinear inverse problems, including forward operators realized by pretrained neural networks, for which existing methods produce unsatisfactory results or fail completely.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PnP-CF，将 flow-matching 去噪器与 ADMM 式对偶变量更新、时间自适应的 pullback 机制结合，用于求解线性与非线性逆问题（含神经网络前向算子）。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 flow 采样器与逆问题求解器的交替迭代及「共识」稳定机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的生成与更新、以及与视觉证据保持一致提供方法线索，可供核查。
